first.text:
My mistake — I pointed you at the wrong page. The setup link isn't on the athlete page; it's at the top of every routine page instead.

Open any one of them on your phone — Monday press, Wednesday pull-up, Friday squat, Saturday bench, Sunday deadlift, the conditioning circuit, or the daily hang — and a few lines down, just before the session itself, you'll see **"Set up the home kit in plate-pool"**. Tap that once and your home kit is saved in the app. After that, the shorter "Load it in plate-pool" links next to each lift will open with the right bar and plates already picked out.
